tm.今は 奥へと進み 命の大樹へ向かおう。: For now, let's go deeper and head for Yggdrasil.
tm.「……ホメロスのヤツが 魔法を放ってきた時は\n オレたちも おしまいかと思った: "When Jasper cast that spell, I thought we were finished. Thanks to you, we barely got out alive.
tm.「それにしても あんな すげえ剣を\n どこで 手に入れてきたんだ？\n もう: "Still, where did you get such an amazing sword? Though it seems to have shattered to pieces...
tm.「ホメロスの あの すさまじい殺気……。\n 本気で あたしたちを倒そうとしてた: "Jasper's murderous aura was terrifying. He truly meant to defeat us. I'm so glad everyone is safe...
tm.「でも アイツの尾行に よく気づいたわね。\n アンタが いてくれなかったら\n: "But you did well to notice he was tailing us. If you hadn't been here, we'd have been in real danger...
tm.「魔物の手先だった ホメロスは倒れました……。\n 次に対決するべきは ウルノー: "Jasper, the monsters' lackey, has fallen... Next we must face Mordegon. Our journey is finally nearing its climax.
tm.「それにしても ウルノーガは いったい\n どこに 身をひそめているのでしょう？: "But where is Mordegon hiding? I hope there is some clue.
tm.「ホメロスちゃんは 悪い子だったみたいだけど\n わざわざ 大樹ちゃんの てっぺ: "Jasper was a bad boy, but why would he come all the way to Yggdrasil's top? What was his business?
tm.「聞きたいことが いろいろあったのに\n 王さまが やっつけちゃったせいで\n: "I had so many questions, but now that the King defeated him, we'll never know...
tm.「やっと お父さまに会えたというのに\n どうしてかしら……？\n なんだか 素: "I finally met Father at last, so why...? Somehow I can't simply be glad.
tm.「ごめんなさい {var:1}。\n まだ お父さまに会えた実感が わかないのよ: "I'm sorry, {var:1}. It still doesn't feel real that I met Father. Maybe it's the sixteen-year gap...
tm.「ホメロスは 魔物の手先じゃった……。\n ヤツの これまでの行いを見る限り\n: "Jasper was a lackey of the monsters... Judging by all he did, there's no doubt about that.
tm.「ウルノーガの居所は まだ 定かではないが\n 勇者のつるぎは ヤツとの対決に欠: "Mordegon's whereabouts are unknown, but the Luminary's sword is essential to face him. Take it from Yggdrasil.
tm.「おいおい {var:1}。\n 勇者のつるぎが 目の前にあるっていうのに\n: "Hey, {var:1}. The Luminary's sword is right in front of you, so where are you going?
tm.「世界のどこかにいる ウルノーガを倒すのが\n 勇者の……お前の使命なんだろ？\: "Defeating Mordegon, somewhere in the world, is the Luminary's mission, right? Let's get the Luminary's sword quickly.
tm.扉は かたく 閉ざされている。\n不思議な形の くぼみがあるが\nカギ穴は どこ: The door is firmly shut. There's an oddly shaped hollow, but no keyhole anywhere.
tm.「ちょっと {var:1}！\n 寄り道なんて してないで\n 早く 勇者のつる: "Hey, {var:1}! Don't detour, let's quickly go return the Luminary's sword.
tm.大樹の魂の中に 入りますか？: Enter the soul of the Great Tree?
tm.大樹の魂は 神々しい光を放っている。: The soul of the Great Tree emits a divine light.
